name: 声明式证据组合优化
description: 对批准 JSON 中至多16项固定声明式候选调用 BudgetedEvidenceSelector。必填：schema_version=1.0、budget、cost_unit、context、time_hours、required字符串数组、sources数组(id/independence_group)、actions数组(id/cost/cost_unit/distinguishes/source_ids/context/time_hours/independent_unit/quantity)。行动可选prerequisites/description/supplies/interpretation_gate/expected_outcomes，顶层可选weights。精确目标依次为声明加权覆盖最大、成本最小、行动数最少、标识符顺序；未知前置条件和解释门不计入可解释单步覆盖。可选composition(id/shared_control_saving)对恰好两个required假设调用PlanComposer/rank_plans，单独报告条件计划排名及预算；不与set-cover联合求解、不认证任何测量。 Uses select_expected_coverage with declared detection_power. Shared source independence_group components use max(p); conditional independence is assumed only between components. Outputs dependence_groups and assumptions. This is a conservative coverage objective, not information gain.
use_when: 批准数据中已明确列出候选行动、预算及成本单位、来源、独立单元、上下文、时间和已命名的生物量，需要精确小规模覆盖方案。
do_not_use_when: 成本或来源未声明，候选数超过16，或需要推测前置条件已测量、全局研究效用、未声明组合折扣或实验结果；不支持set-cover与组合的联合最优。
